arxiv-1905-05207.title: APS η \eta -invariant, path integrals, and mock modularity
arxiv-1905-05207.creator: Atish Dabholkar, Diksha Jain, Arnab Rudra
arxiv-1905-05207.description: Abstract We show that the Atiyah-Patodi-Singer η \eta -invariant can be related to the temperature dependent Witten index of a noncompact theory and give a new proof of the APS theorem using scattering theory. We relate the η \eta -invariant to a Callias index and compute it using localization of a supersymmetric path integral.

arxiv-1908-04854.title: Tomographic analyses of the CMB lensing and galaxy clustering to probe the linear structure growth
arxiv-1908-04854.creator: Armando Bernui
arxiv-1908-04854.description: Abstract In a tomographic approach, we measure the cross-correlation between the CMB lensing reconstructed from the Planck satellite and the galaxies of the photometric redshift catalogue based on the combination of the South Galactic Cap u-band Sky Survey (SCUSS), Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS), and Wide-field Infrared Survey Explorer (WISE) data.

arxiv-2112-04454.title: Greedy based Value Representation for Optimal Coordination in Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2112-04454.creator: Lipeng Wan, Zeyang Liu, Xingyu Chen, Xuguang Lan, Nanning Zheng
arxiv-2112-04454.description: Abstract Due to the representation limitation of the joint Q value function, multi-agent reinforcement learning methods with linear value decomposition (LVD) or monotonic value decomposition (MVD) suffer from relative overgeneralization. As a result, they can not ensure optimal consistency (i.e., the correspondence between individual greedy actions and the maximal true Q value).

arxiv-2204-04823.title: ACuTE: Automatic Curriculum Transfer from Simple to Complex Environments Conference: Proc.of the 21st International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2022); May 9–13, 2022; Online 719
arxiv-2204-04823.creator: Yash Shukla, Christopher Thierauf, Ramtin Hosseini, Gyan Tatiya, Jivko Sinapov
arxiv-2204-04823.description: Abstract . Despite recent advances in Reinforcement Learning (RL), many problems, especially real-world tasks, remain prohibitively expensive to learn. To address this issue, several lines of research have explored how tasks, or data samples themselves, can be sequenced into a curriculum to learn a problem that may otherwise be too difficult to learn from scratch.

arxiv-2206-14514.title: Quasi-bound state in the K ¯ ​ N ​ N ​ N \bar{K}NNN system
arxiv-2206-14514.creator: N.V. Shevchenko
arxiv-2206-14514.description: Abstract The paper is devoted to the K ¯ ​ N ​ N ​ N \bar{K}NNN system, which is an exotic system consisting of an antikaon and three nucleons. Dynamically exact four-body Faddeev-type equations were solved and characteristics of the quasi-bound state in the system were evaluated.

arxiv-2211-12101.title: Efficient Sampling Algorithms for Approximate Motif Counting in Temporal Graph Streams CCS: Theory of computation Sketching and sampling CCS: Theory of computation Graph algorithms analysis
arxiv-2211-12101.creator: Jingjing Wang, Yanhao Wang, Wenjun Jiang, Yuchen Li, Kian-Lee Tan
arxiv-2211-12101.description: Abstract . A great variety of complex systems ranging from user interactions in communication networks to transactions in financial markets can be modeled as temporal graphs , which consist of a set of vertices and a series of timestamped and directed edges.

arxiv-2306-05126.title: Mapping Brains with Language Models: A Survey
arxiv-2306-05126.creator: Antonia Karamolegkou 1, Mostafa Abdou 2, Anders Søgaard 1
arxiv-2306-05126.description: Abstract Over the years, many researchers have seemingly made the same observation: Brain and language model activations exhibit some structural similarities, enabling linear partial mappings between features extracted from neural recordings and computational language models. In an attempt to evaluate how much evidence has been accumulated for this observation, we survey over 30 studies spanning 10 datasets and 8 metrics.

arxiv-2409-03483.title: Defects and type D relativistic Toda lattice for some 5d gauge theories
arxiv-2409-03483.creator: Kimyeong Lee, and Norton Lee
arxiv-2409-03483.description: Abstract We perform folding on the ADHM construction of the instanton moduli space from S ​ U SU to S ​ O SO group. A Young diagram description for the S ​ O SO instanton is obtained after modifying the real and complex moment maps of the ADHM data.

arxiv-2410-04695.title: Weak sharp minima at infinity and solution stability in mathematical programming via asymptotic analysis
arxiv-2410-04695.creator: Felipe Lara 1, Nguyen Van Tuyen 2, Tran Van Nghi 3
arxiv-2410-04695.description: Abstract . We develop sufficient conditions for the existence of the weak sharp minima at infinity property for nonsmooth optimization problems via asymptotic cones and generalized asymptotic functions. Next, we show that these conditions are also useful for studying the solution stability of nonconvex optimization problems under linear perturbations.

arxiv-2505-13450.title: Fractal Analysis on the Real Interval: A Constructive Approach via Fractal Countability
arxiv-2505-13450.creator: Stanislav Semenov
arxiv-2505-13450.description: Abstract This paper develops a technical and practical reinterpretation of the real interval [ a , b ] [a,b] under the paradigm of fractal countability. Instead of assuming the continuum as a completed uncountable totality, we model [ a , b ] [a,b] as a layered structure of constructively definable points, indexed by a hierarchy of formal systems.

hippocrates-genuine-works-adams-vol-2.creator: Hippocrates (Francis Adams, trans.)
hippocrates-genuine-works-adams-vol-2.description: Hippocrates, Adams translation, Vol. 2 — surgery, fractures, dislocations, and the instruments of ancient medicine.

pmc-10611223.title: Toxic Effects of Koumine on the Early-Life Development Stage of Zebrafish
pmc-10611223.creator: Dongjie Wang, Xinyi Leng, Yao Tian, Jiangdong Liu, Jixing Zou, Shaolin Xie, Robyn L Tanguay, Demetrio Raldúa
pmc-10611223.description: Koumine is one of the most abundant alkaloids found in Gelsemium elegans, and it has a wide range of pharmacological effects including antitumor, anti-inflammatory, analgesic treatment effects, and antianxiety. However, its high toxicity and unclear mechanism of action have greatly limited the medicinal development and use of koumine.

pmc-11306063.title: The association of appendicular skeletal muscle mass with anthropometric, body composition, nutritional, inflammatory, and metabolic variables in non-dialysis-dependent chronic kidney disease men
pmc-11306063.creator: Katarzyna Romejko, Katarzyna Szamotulska, Aleksandra Rymarz, Rozmyslowicz Tomasz, Stanisław Niemczyk
pmc-11306063.description: BackgroundMuscle atrophy affects more than 50% of patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) and is associated with increased morbidity and mortality. It is crucial to understand the mechanisms involved in the muscle atrophy in CKD and search for specific determinants of skeletal muscle mass loss, especially those which are available in everyday medical practice.

pmc-11538617.title: NFAT5 counters long-term IFN-1 responses in hematopoietic stem cells to preserve reconstitution potential∗
pmc-11538617.creator: Laia Traveset, Víctor Cerdán Porqueras, Hector Huerga Encabo, Silvia Avalle, Anna Esteve-Codina, Oscar Fornas, Jose Aramburu, Cristina Lopez-Rodriguez
pmc-11538617.description: Key Points•IFN-1 drives HSCs toward more differentiated progenitors in response to hematopoietic stressors.•NFAT5 has an HSC-intrinsic role, limiting long-term IFN-1 responses to preserve reconstitution potential. Introduction Adult hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) are quiescent precursors that can divide to self-renew or differentiate to restock all blood lineages.

pmc-11584214.title: A Rare Case of Darier Disease Flaring Up During Pregnancy
pmc-11584214.creator: Vidya Gaikwad, Jay Patel, Himali Hatwar
pmc-11584214.description: Darier disease (DD), which was also known as keratosis follicularis or Darier-White disease, is an autosomal dominant hereditary illness. The illness typically first manifests in adolescence and progresses as a woman reaches reproductive age. Research on the potential effects of DD on the skin and fetus, especially when it affects the groin and vulva, is insufficient.

pmc-11657228.title: Challenges and solutions in implementing electronic prescribing in Iran’s health system: a qualitative study
pmc-11657228.creator: Neda Borhani Moghani, Elahe Hooshmand, Marzie Zarqi, Marziyhe Meraji
pmc-11657228.description: BackgroundThe use of electronic prescribing is recognized as a strategic tool for improving healthcare. Given the nationwide implementation of electronic prescribing systems initiated in 2020, this study aims to explore the challenges and solutions for implementing electronic prescribing in Iran’s health system as a developing country.

pmc-12443646.title: Augmenting conventional criteria: a CT-based deep learning radiomics nomogram for early recurrence risk stratification in hepatocellular carcinoma after liver transplantation
pmc-12443646.creator: Ziqian Wu, Danyang Liu, Siyu Ouyang, Jingyi Hu, Jie Ding, Qiu Guo, Jidong Gao, Jiawen Luo, Ke Ren
pmc-12443646.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundWe developed a deep learning radiomics nomogram (DLRN) using CT scans to improve clinical decision-making and risk stratification for early recurrence of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) after transplantation, which typically has a poor prognosis.Materials and methodsIn this two-center study, 245 HCC patients who had contrast-enhanced CT before liver transplantation were split into a training set (n = 184) and a validation set (n = 61). We extracted radiomics and deep learning features from tumor and peritumor areas on preoperative CT images.

pmc-12586668.title: Multi-stage iterative compressed sensing framework based on DIFF transformer and ISTA for remote sensing images
pmc-12586668.creator: Rongrong Wang, Yong Fang
pmc-12586668.description: In remote sensing applications, image storage and compression require large amounts of memory and consume a lot of battery power. Compressed sensing (CS) can alleviate these problems while shifting the complexity to the decoding end. However, existing methods still face limitations, such as attention noise in standard Transformer architectures and gradient instability in deep-unfolded ISTA variants.

pmc-12616905.title: Characterization and bioactivities of glutaminase-free L-asparaginase from Salinicola acorporae S4-41
pmc-12616905.creator: Abd El Raheem El-Shanshoury, Hadeer Helmy Abosamra, Tamer Elsakhawy
pmc-12616905.description: BackgroundThe medical community has long searched for a safer and more effective cancer treatment method. Clinically, L-asparaginase derived from bacteria has shown promising results. However, it carries the risk of immunological and hypersensitive reactions due to its interaction with glutaminase. Therefore, finding a new source of glutaminase-free L-asparaginase (ASNase) is important.

pmc-12717826.title: Comparative Effectiveness of Non-Pharmacological Interventions for Postpartum Depression and Anxiety: A Network Meta-Analysis
pmc-12717826.creator: Yuqin Zhu, Weicheng Yang, Na Li, Jinfeng Yang, Jinqi Yang, Yan Zheng, Wen Chen, Yunchang Yang, Yunlu Liu, Yan Zhao
pmc-12717826.description: BackgroundPostpartum depression (PPD), a prevalent perinatal mood disorder characterized by persistent depressive and anxiety symptoms, significantly impacts maternal-infant health. The COVID-19 pandemic has further increased the global burden of PPD, emphasizing the need for effective and accessible interventions. Although non-pharmacological interventions are widely used, their comparative efficacy remains uncertain.

pmc-13388423.title: A damage-aware NGS workflow for conservative species identification from ultra-degraded DNA
pmc-13388423.creator: Stefania Morelli, Sara Romano, Giulia Cosenza, Sergio Abate, Livia Lombardi, Elena Pilli

pmc-13627737.title: Interfollicular communication among preovulatory follicles after luteinizing hormone signaling
pmc-13627737.creator: Corie M Owen, Siu-Pok Yee, Laurinda A Jaffe
pmc-13627737.description: Luteinizing hormone (LH) triggers the resumption of oocyte meiosis and ovulation in preovulatory ovarian follicles. These events have generally been viewed as autonomous responses occurring independently within each follicle. Here, however, we show that mouse preovulatory follicles can communicate with one another through an LH-induced paracrine signaling network.

pmc-13634104.title: Novel treatment of celiac trunk and proximal splenic artery aneurysms in vascular Ehlers-Danlos patient with combined Onyx and coil embolization
pmc-13634104.creator: Amani Politano, Tiffany Lian, Harish Krishnamoorthi, Cherrie Abraham, Sherene Shalhub, John Kaufman
pmc-13634104.description: Vascular Ehlers-Danlos syndrome is associated with severe arterial fragility and life-threatening visceral complications. We report a 30-year-old woman with genetically confirmed vascular Ehlers-Danlos syndrome who presented with abdominal pain, nausea, and emesis. Persistent symptoms prompted serial computed tomography angiography (CTA), which revealed progressive celiac trunk and splenic artery dissections with multiple pseudoaneurysms.
